create_padding_same: create padding that matches input size for stride 1 convolutions using the same function
create_padding_causal: create pre-padding for causal convolutions so output has no dependence on the future
create_padding_full: create maximal padding for full convolutions without convolving over just padded elements
generate_padding_from_padfn: generate padding tuples from a PadFn callable given kernel size, dilation rate, and spatial dimensions
create_padding_from_tuple: create a padding sequence from a partially specified tuple replicated across n spatial dimensions
